newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTOR RACING-IRVINE TO STAY WITH FERRARI IN 1998.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-IRVINE TO STAY WITH FERRARI IN 1998.

text.p: Briton Eddie Irvine will remain with Ferrari in 1998, the Italian Formula One team said in a brief statement on Thursday.
Irvine's contract had been up for renewal and the Ferrari announcement came just hours before the team's option on his services expired.
The approaching deadline sparked numerous media rumours that Ferrari were seeking a possible replacement for Irvine to drive alongside twice world champion Michael Schumacher next year.
But Ferrari said they planned to stick with the Briton who has four podium finishes to his name this year and is currently sixth in the drivers' championship.

"The Scuderia Ferrari Marlboro announces they have exercised the existing option with the Grand Prix driver Eddie Irvine in respect of the 1998 sporting season," Ferrari's one paragraph statement said.
Irvine, in his second season with the Italian giants, plays second fiddle to twice-world champion Schumacher, who leads this year's drivers' championship.
The Ferrari team are also top of the constructors championship.
